benign.title: A losing player loses to the whole table
benign.text: One player loses -120 bb per 100 hands overall (worse than 95% of pairs). Chips flowing to the partner may be part of losing to everyone.

benign.title: Similar playing styles
benign.text: Their overall styles are closer than 94% of pairs (distance 0.11). Two players with the same habits make the same choices without any agreement.

benign.title: Too few hands to be sure
benign.text: They played only 2% of the table's hands together (fewer than 92% of pairs). A few big pots can swing every rate; treat the scores as weak evidence.
